name: ILLUSTRATIVE Tutor Demo
problemStatement: Explain why any whole number divisible by 6 must also be divisible by both 2 and 3.

hints.label: Hint 01
hints.title: Prime Factors
hints.content: Recall that 6 can be broken down into 2 multiplied by 3.

hints.label: Hint 02
hints.title: Divisibility Definition
hints.content: If a number is a multiple of 6, it can be written as 6 multiplied by some whole number.

hints.label: Hint 03
hints.title: Conclusion
hints.content: Substituting 6 with 2 times 3 proves the number contains both 2 and 3 as factors.

calibration.label: Confidence Estimation
calibration.sub: Rate your confidence before unlocking hints or submitting your reasoning.

humanRule: In development. In the actual classroom, the no-device quiz run by humans always wins.
